scoring_justification: Fully recompute band inversion (gap < 0), node-line closure around Z, Berry phase pattern (π/0), and flat surface band from the agent's raw JSON arrays; compare against the paper's expected topological properties.

required.kpath: array of objects, each with 'label' (string) and 'k' (array of 3 floats, fractional coordinates)
required.eigenvalues: array of arrays, each inner array of 4 floats representing the 4 band energies in eV
required.node_line_points: array of arrays of 3 floats, fractional coordinates of the closed node line

outputs.description: Bulk tight-binding band structure and identified node line points.

required.k_parallel: array of arrays of 2 floats (k2, k3) in fractional coordinates
required.berry_phase: array of floats, Berry phase in units of π

outputs.description: Berry phase computed for the zigzag termination as a function of in-plane momentum.

required.k_path: array of arrays of 2 floats, surface BZ k-point coordinates
required.eigenvalues: array of arrays, each inner array containing the slab band eigenvalues in eV

outputs.description: Surface band structure of the beard-terminated (100) slab.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify the band inversion at Z (negative gap), the closed loop of node_line_points, the quantization of Berry phase (π outside / 0 inside), and the presence of drumhead-like flat bands inside the node ring. Tolerances and reference patterns are derived from the paper and are hidden.

hidden_assets.purpose: topological and structural criteria extracted from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text, Fig. 1(c)-(e), Fig. 2, and the definition of the node-line semimetal state
hidden_assets.generation_method: expected structural properties derived from the paper's reported band inversion, node-line geometry, Berry phase quantization, and drumhead surface states; no external gold files required
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: the criteria are the paper's own reported qualitative and quantitative features, not invented; the checker recomputes them from the agent's raw arrays and never trusts a self-reported number

steps.description: Verify band inversion at Z point: gap between the two central bands is negative (conduction below valence).
Verify node line forms a closed loop in the k_x≈0 plane surrounding Z (0,0,0.5).
Verify Berry phase pattern: ~π outside the projected node line, ~0 inside.
Verify existence of a nearly flat drumhead surface state inside the projected node ring.
